YASH THARWANI 
CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT  

+91 7499188655 | yashtharwani7877@gmail.com |   www.linkedin.com/in/yash-tharwani |   Mumbai 
 

ACADEMIC AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 

COURSE YEAR  INSTITUTION MARKS REMARKS 

CA Final  (1st attempt) Jan 2026 ICAI 316/600  Exemption in Direct Tax 

CA Inter  (1st attempt) Nov 2022 ICAI 463/800  Exemption in 3 subjects 

CA Foundation (1st attempt) July 2021 ICAI 257/400  Exemption in 3 out of 4 subjects 

B.COM.  2021-2024 C.H.M. College  9.20 GPI - 

Class XII 2021 C.H.M. College 89% - 

Class X 2019 Jhulelal Trust School 91% 3rd rank in School 

PROFILE SUMMARY 

Newly qualified Chartered Accountant (All levels cleared in the first attempt) with hands-on experience in statutory audits, 

financial analysis, and financial statement review across multiple industries. Skilled in analytical review, variance analysis, 

and identifying key business and financial drivers through detailed examination of financial data. Keen to apply my financial 

knowledge and analytical capabilities to deliver high-quality financial analysis and support business decision-making. 

WORK EXPERIENCE   

B. K. Khare & Co. (Mumbai, India)                                                                                                                     (Feb, 2023 – Feb, 2026)  
(Renowned CA firm with 10 Partners, Headquartered in Mumbai, and 4 Branch Offices at prime locations, providing services in 
Assurance, Risk Advisory, Corporate & Transfer Pricing Taxation, Indirect Tax, and Transaction Advisory for over 70 Years.) 
 

Statutory Audit: 
A key member of audit teams performing end-to-end statutory audit procedures including process understanding, walkthroughs, 
test of controls (TOC) and substantive testing (TOD), while ensuring compliance with IGAAP/ Ind AS and Schedule III of the 
Companies Act, 2013. Engagements spanned clients across industries such as pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, logistics & 
supply chain services, financial services (NBFCs), and specialty chemicals. 

 
o Performed analytical review and financial analysis procedures including periodic variance analysis, quantity-rate 

variance analysis, ratio analysis, and trend analysis. Identified financial anomalies and independently discussed 
observations with finance controllers. Notably detected an understatement of ₹25 crores in Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) arising 
from incorrect expense classification. 
 

o Independently executed audit of loan portfolios and interest income for an Infrastructure Finance Company with an asset 
size exceeding ₹15,000 crores, ensuring compliance with Ind AS 109, including aspects of asset recognition and income 
recognition. Also managed and reviewed regulatory and lender-related certifications such as creditors’ certificates, DNBS-10 
returns, and fund utilization certificates. Independently handled audit of investments and borrowings for a housing 
finance company with an asset base exceeding ₹10,000 crores. 
  

o Led a team of 3 members on the statutory audit of a ₹250+ crore valve assembly manufacturing public company, reporting 
directly to the Senior Manager. Identified non-compliance with AS 2 due to incorrect capitalization of indirect expenses in 
inventory and escalated the issue to management. Received appreciation from the Engagement Partner for strong execution 
and ownership of the assignment. 
 

o Participated as an integral member of the audit team for SFS and CFS of a ₹1,300+ crore revenue leading TMT bars 
manufacturing company. Also, assisted in buyback certification under Section 68 of the Companies Act, 2013. Evaluated 
the client’s ECL computation under Ind AS 109, identified gaps in impairment assessment, and recommended an appropriate 
valuation methodology for Debtors. 
 

o Assisted in preparation of audit reports, CARO reports, and Audit Committee Meeting (ACM) presentations, summarizing 
key audit findings and observations for communication to management and the Audit Committee. 
 

o Contributed as a primary member of tax audit teams for clients across multiple sectors, including a leading logistics & supply 
chain services company with turnover exceeding ₹5,000 crores. 

 

ACHIEVEMENTS, CERTIFICATIONS & EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES  

1. Received ‘Article of the Quarter’ award twice from B. K. Khare & Co. 
2. Represented my school in Inter-School Badminton Tournament at the State Level. 
3. Jr. Brown belt in Shotokan Karate (at the age of 13) 
4. Earned formal client appreciation for efficient audit execution and on-time completion of engagement deliverables. 

 
 

mailto:yashtharwani7877@gmail.com
http://www.linkedin.com/in/yash-tharwani
